nidoran-m-sludge-bomb.name: Sludge Bomb
nidoran-m-sludge-bomb.description: Bond skill: lobs sludge up to 3 hexes away (Power 75), Poisoning the foe for 2 turns.

nidoran-m-poison-jab.name: Poison Jab
nidoran-m-poison-jab.description: Bond skill: darts up to 2 hexes into a foe (Power 70), engaging it; Poisons 1 turn.

nidoran-m-poison-point.name: Poison Point
nidoran-m-poison-point.description: Its damaging hits on adjacent foes Poison them for 1 turn.

nidoran-m-hustle.name: Hustle
nidoran-m-hustle.description: Deals 15% more damage but takes 10% more damage.

nidoran-m-focus-energy.name: Focus Energy
nidoran-m-focus-energy.description: New skill: pumps itself up, becoming Focused for 2 turns.

nidoran-m-venom-hunter.name: Venom Hunter
nidoran-m-venom-hunter.description: Deals 20% more damage to Poisoned foes.

nidoran-m-nimble-retreat.name: Nimble Retreat
nidoran-m-nimble-retreat.description: Steps away from engaged foes without drawing free strikes.

nidoran-m-iron-tail.name: Iron Tail
nidoran-m-iron-tail.description: New skill: slams a foe with its hardened tail (Power 85).

nidoran-m-rampage.name: Rampage
nidoran-m-rampage.description: Gains 1 Attack for the battle (up to +3) whenever it knocks out a foe.

nidoran-m-potent-venom.name: Potent Venom
nidoran-m-potent-venom.description: Statuses it inflicts last 1 turn longer.

nidoran-m-sheer-force.name: Sheer Force
nidoran-m-sheer-force.description: Its Poison- and Ground-type moves deal 15% more damage.

nidoran-m-earthen-lord.name: Earthen Lord
nidoran-m-earthen-lord.description: Foes engaged with it always draw its free strike when leaving; free strikes +25%.

nidoran-m-earth-power.name: Earth Power
nidoran-m-earth-power.description: New skill: the ground erupts under a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 70).

nidoran-m-drill-run.name: Drill Run
nidoran-m-drill-run.description: New skill: drills horn-first through a 2-hex line (Power 60).

nidoran-m-pack-leader.name: Pack Leader
nidoran-m-pack-leader.description: Deals 20% more damage to foes carrying a status an ally applied.

nidoran-m-tyrants-wrath.name: Tyrant's Wrath
nidoran-m-tyrants-wrath.description: Deals 20% more damage while below half HP.

nidoran-m-nidokings-reign.name: Nidoking's Reign
nidoran-m-nidokings-reign.description: Capstone. Each knockout resets its skill cooldowns and heals it 10% of its max HP.

nidoran-m-rampaging-king.name: Rampaging King
nidoran-m-rampaging-king.description: Capstone. Thrashes about: each hit in a row on the same foe deals 15% more, up to 3 stacks.

nidoran-m-horn-drill.name: Horn Drill
nidoran-m-horn-drill.description: Bond skill: drives its spinning horn into a foe (Power 100, Attack).

nidoran-m-poison-tail.name: Poison Tail
nidoran-m-poison-tail.description: New skill: a quick lash of its venomous tail (Power 55).

nidoran-m-mud-shot.name: Mud Shot
nidoran-m-mud-shot.description: New skill: hurls mud at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 50), Slowing it for 1 turn.

nidoran-m-sludge-wave.name: Sludge Wave
nidoran-m-sludge-wave.description: New skill: a wave of sludge hits every adjacent foe (Power 65), Poisoning for 1 turn.

nidoran-m-stomping-tantrum.name: Stomping Tantrum
nidoran-m-stomping-tantrum.description: New skill: stomps furiously on a foe (Power 70).
